svg.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
svg.title: Bayu Anchor schematic
svg.desc: Schematic of the Bayu Anchor: XIAO ESP32-S3 (U1) with Wio-SX1262 (U2) on its B2B connector, SEN54 (U3) and SHT40 (U4) on I2C_SDA (D4) and I2C_SCL (D5) with 4.7 kOhm pull-ups R1 and R2 to +3V3, PMS5003 (U5) on UART D6/D7 with SET on D2, +5V from USB VBUS.
svg.text: Same circuit as the breadboard and the Core map. Net names in colour match the wire colours. Pin numbers are the connector pins of each part.
D8–D10 share the radio's SPI. Leave them free.

g.text: CERN-OHL-W-2.0 · Meaningful Design Group / Fab Lab Bali · github.com/Meaningful-Design-Group/makingsensebali
